title: Tom yum with prawns and mushrooms
steps: Bruise the lemongrass and cut it into pieces, slice the ginger.
Simmer with the lime leaves and chilli in the stock for 10 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes and simmer for 4 minutes; soak the rice noodles separately.
Add the prawns and cook for 2–3 minutes, then season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Put the noodles in bowls, pour over the soup and sprinkle with coriander (do not eat the lemongrass and leaves).
